|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. The current text is [[A Jedi's Plans (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-59-A_Jedis_Plans-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[A Jedi's Plans (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on a site. Nightfall is canceled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to ▼ Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except a sector) not on table. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 7, slip 59. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-59-A_Jedis_Plans.png]]) prints slip number “59” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “cancelled” for “canceled” and “(except sector)” for “(except a sector)” (it writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “Deploy on a site. Nightfall is cancelled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to deploy Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except sector) not on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1250_59-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Jedi's Plans (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-ajedisplans-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/ajedisplans.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual5-Light], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock5-Light/large/ajedisplans.gif</ref>: “Deploy on a site. Nightfall is canceled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to ▼ Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except a sector) not on table. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 5 set mark) and prints the number “59” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does; its caption bottom left reads “•Wise Advice (V)”, the label of another card.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[A Jedi's Plans (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 21), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=21, page 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=21 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a site. Nightfall is canceled. While you have 8 or fewer cards in hand, non-unique characters (except clones), vehicles, starships, weapons, and devices are immune to Monnok. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to ▼ Jedi Archives or a battleground planet location (except a sector) not on table. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-59-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it shows the whole card top (title bar and lore) with the slip pasted over the lower part; the label under the slip reads “•Wise Advice (V)”, the label of another card.
